name: Takander
overview: Boul is a young Franco-Senegalese man who was born and raised in Paris. As an organizer of underground fights, he is often mistreated and underpaid by his employer, Franck. Frustrated by his situation, he embezzles 300,000 euros and flees to Dakar with his girlfriend, Aïssa. Away from the stress of Paris, Boul hopes for a fresh start to achieve his biggest dream: becoming the greatest promoter in the history of Senegalese wrestling. But unfortunately, reality catches up with him, and Franck is on their trail. Will he be able to survive in the Dakar underworld and fulfill his dream?
